Topic.label: Common Types of Word Problems Involving Systems of Equations

Question: A 10% salt solution and a 20% salt solution are mixed to make 50 kg of a 16% salt solution. How many kg of the 10% salt solution and the 20% salt solution are needed? (Give the answers in this order, in kg, separated by a comma.)
Solution: Let the amounts of the 10% salt solution and the 20% salt solution be \(x\) kg and \(y\) kg, respectively: \(x+y=50\), \(0.1x+0.2y=50\times0.16=8\). Solving gives \(x=20\), \(y=30\).
